title: Engine operations
description: The functions through which the page and the Worker drive a game.

entities.name: Create a game
entities.description: A game on its title screen, holding the seed the next game will start from.
entities.transport: constructor (new Game(seed)); the page then sets nextSeed to a seed the server issued
entities.authorization: None: an in-process class. The page (src/main.ts) and replay() construct it.
entities.result: A Game in the attract phase with a full, swaying hive; nextSeed is the seed given.

entities.name: Step a game
entities.description: Advances the game by one frame (1/60 s) with one frame's Input.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process method. The page (src/main.ts) and replay() call it.
entities.result: The game is changed in place; the frame's events (start, ready, shoot, hit, queen, dive, die, extra, wave, over, pause) are returned for the sound. On the title screen, start1 or start2 starts a one- or two-player game from nextSeed.

entities.name: Record a frame's controls
entities.description: Adds one frame's Input to a game's recording.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process method. The page (src/main.ts) calls it on every frame of a game.
entities.result: The Input is packed into six bits (toBits); a frame like the last lengthens the last run, any other starts a new [bits, 1] run. The frame count grows by one.

entities.name: Replay a recorded game
entities.description: Plays a recorded game again from its seed, as the server does before listing a score.
entities.authorization: None: an in-process function. The Worker (worker/index.ts, through worker/scores.ts) and the tests call it.
entities.result: How many played, each player's final score and wave, and the number of frames.
failures: null when the runs are not a non-empty, even-length array of at most MAX_RUNS pairs.
null when a run's bits are not a whole number from 0 to 63, or its count is not a whole number of at least 1.
null when the runs add up to more than MAX_FRAMES (two hours).
null when the first frame does not start a game from the title screen.
null when frames are left over after the game ended, or the game has not ended by the last frame.

relatedViews.relationship: The features these operations carry out.
